Target company: Microsoft (MSFT). Microsoft develops software and cloud services including Windows, Microsoft 365 and Azure, and operates gaming, business-software and related technology businesses.

Focal announcement: Microsoft Ability Summit 2025: Accessibility in the AI era.

Decision cutoff: 2025-03-18T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Microsoft Ability Summit 2025: Accessibility in the AI era. Published date: 2025-03-18. URL: https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2025/03/18/microsoft-ability-summit-2025-accessibility-in-the-ai-era.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: Today, we hosted the 15th annual Microsoft Ability Summit, with over 20,000 attendees from 164 countries coming together virtually to discuss the future of AI and accessibility. Copilot for Microsoft 365 is unlocking workplace productivity like never before, more than 10 million people use Edge each month to have the web Read Aloud , over 1 million people use Immersive Reader to make webpages easier to read and partners like Tobii Dynavox and Special Olympics are bringing AI to people with disabilities globally. Here’s a quick summary of the new accessibility products, features and programs announced at the 2025 Ability Summit. Over 5 million learners around the world have participated in our Accessibility Skilling program and we’re grateful to our partners including Teach Access , Computacenter UK and the City of New York .
